assumptions: CLI route `--metric hdrvdp` -> cpu_dispatch.rs:670 hdrvdp::score (NOT hdrvdp()): prepare() (metric.rs:255-330) -> masking::run_terms (masking.rs:188) -> quality_correlate (pool.rs:133) -> 100-Q. The full `hdrvdp()` visibility reconstruction (P_map/P_det inverse pyramid) is NOT on this path (metric.rs:226-244).

prepare(): to_nits per channel (display.rs:127) -> surround geometric-mean per channel over the REFERENCE (pathway.rs:236-260) -> visual_pathway_with_filter per image (pathway.rs:132-190): (1) optical MTF via conv_fft_real on a 2W x 2H padded plane per channel (fft.rs:1042), (2) LMSR accumulation 4 planes x 3 channels (pathway.rs:157-165), (3) l_adapt = L+M, (4) photoreceptor nonlinear cones L,M + rods R (photoreceptor.rs), (5) remove_mean x2 (global reductions) + cones+rods add -> achromatic plane.

spyr::build (spyr.rs:653-740) on the achromatic plane per image: hi0 corr_dn 15x15 stride1, lo0 9x9 stride1, then per level: 4 orientation BFILTS 9x9 stride1 + LOFILT 17x17 stride-2 decimate. Filters are FULL 2-D FIR kernels (sp3_filters.rs:25,284,387,716 flattened via flat()) - corr_dn is direct 2-D correlation over a materialized reflect1-padded plane (spyr.rs:396-430), NOT separable.

max_pyr_height (spyr.rs:128-136): halves floor(w),floor(h) while both >=17 -> n = floor(log2(min(W,H)/17))+1 approx (exact while halving is sequential floor; modelled as such). Level dims use ceil halving in outputs (div_ceil in corr_dn: out_w=width.div_ceil(step)).

FFT conv cost model: 2W x 2H padded real FFT fwd + pointwise spectral mul + inverse, ~20*log2(4*W*H)+24 flops per ORIGINAL pixel per channel per image (real FFT ~2.5*4N*log2(4N) real flops x2 FFTs + 4N complex mults), plus pad/crop copies.

masking::run_terms (masking.rs:188-400): per band-pair per orientation - mutual_masking magnitudes, cross-orientation mask_xo sum, log10(l_adapt) resize + CSF LUT lerp, mask_xn from neighboring band resamples (imresize32), transducer-shaped difference d, masked_sq_sum fold -> per-band quality term (ln(msre+eps)-ln(eps))*w_f. Total band-plane elements ~ (4*4/3 + residual) * W*H ~ 5.33*W*H.
bands test+ref share band geometry; masking folds produce one f64 term per band pair (b_count = 4*SPYRH + 2).
Parallelism notes: join2 over images, collect_indexed over orientations/bands; per-scale/per-band folds are the barriers.

stages.name: encoding -> absolute nits per channel
stages.notes: sRGB/EOTF decode + scale to cd/m^2 (piecewise transfer ~9 flops/el). Input arrives as f64 channels.

stages.name: per-channel geometric mean of reference (log-domain)
stages.notes: Reference only; non-positive samples skipped; per-channel exp(sum/n).

stages.name: optical MTF via padded real-FFT conv per channel
stages.notes: Pad to 2W x 2H with surround fill (global dependency radius ~W/2), RFFT + spectral multiply + IRFFT + crop; filter shared across pair (pathway.rs:283-289). ~440 flops/px/ch at 1024^2.

stages.name: spectral -> L,M,S,R accumulation (4 planes x 3 ch)
stages.notes: R[k][i] += lmsr[c][k]*optical[c][i]; S plane computed then dropped (upstream parity, pathway.rs:151-153).

stages.name: cone/rod nonlinear response (p_l, p_m, p_r)
stages.notes: Photoreceptor::cone32_plane x2 + rod32_plane (Naka-Rushton-style gain response ~10 flops/el).

stages.name: remove_mean x2 + cones+rods achromatic
stages.notes: Two global mean folds (cones, rods) + subtract + achromatic add; element ops folded into one stage.

stages.name: steerable pyr: HI0FILT 15x15 stride-1 corr
stages.notes: Direct 2-D correlation, 225 taps/output; reflect1 padding materialized as (w+2c)-padded plane (spyr.rs:417-430). Hi-pass at full res.

stages.name: steerable pyr: BFILTS 9x9 x4 orientations per level
stages.notes: Four orientation bands at level dims (no decimation within a level), 81 taps each.

stages.name: steerable pyr: LOFILT 17x17 stride-2 decimate
stages.notes: 289 taps per OUTPUT at half dims; feeds next level's band corrs and ends as low-pass residual.

stages.name: mutual masking magnitudes + cross-orientation sums
stages.notes: mm[b][o] per band-pair (test vs ref); mask_xo_total accumulates over orientations. Total band-plane elements ~5.33*W*H (4 orientations x geometric series + hi/lo).

stages.name: CSF LUT lerp + neighbor resample + transducer + diff
stages.notes: Per band el: log10(l_adapt) imresize32 + CSF LUT linear lerp + mask_xn (neighbor-band resample) + transducer p/q/pf shaping + |test-ref| band diff.

stages.name: masked_sq_sum fold + per-band quality term
stages.notes: msre = sqrt(masked sum d^2)/(bw*bh) then (ln(msre+eps)-ln(eps))*w_f once per band.
